messages:
marta: Heads up — seeing ~20% gpu-attach failures in eu-west1. Failures cluster on a handful of hosts, high iowait and nvme queue stalls in dmesg. Anyone chasing this?

marta: paste of dmesg snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] nvme nvme0: I/O 0 timed out, aborting
[ 1234.568012] blk_mq_dispatch: queue 0 stuck, inflight 128
[ 1234.568345] nvme0n1: end_request: I/O error, dev 8:0, sector 123456
```

alana: yup saw identical traces on gn-evp-123 and gn-evp-124 earlier. Looks like scrub/trim + heavy smallwrite burst from janitor during batch attach window.

ben: can we temporarily cordon those nodes and force attaches to fallback pool? which hosts exactly?

marta: host list: gn-evp-123, gn-evp-124, gn-evp-125, gn-evp-127. Command I'm running now:
```
# cordon and drain less disruptively
kubectl cordon gn-evp-123
kubectl drain gn-evp-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```

tony: immediate mitigation checklist from my side: reduce janitor concurrency to 2 (ops/janitor config), pause nightly fstrim/nvme-scrub on affected hosts, and back off the autoscaler (shorten scale-up aggressiveness).

tony: to pause scrub: `ssh gn-evp-123 sudo systemctl stop nvme-scrub.service && sudo systemctl disable --now nvme-scrub.service` — do this only on the impacted hosts.

alana: also adding a routing fallback in the attach service to avoid those hosts for 30m while we stabilize. pushed a canary route that shifts attaches to eu-west2 for small jobs.

deploy-bot: Router policy updated: attach-routing (eu-west1 hotlist) -> eu-west2 (canary, 30m).

ben: longer-term: schedule SMART baseline and non-destructive badblocks on the hosts, and consider retiring drives that show >5% reallocated sectors. We'll need spare capacity to avoid expensive emergency replacements.

marta: agreed. I'm opening INC-4319 for tracking: summary, mitigation, next-steps (SMART runs, drive retirement criteria, janitor throttling defaults). Will post updates here. :white_check_mark:

alana: small note on cost tradeoffs — keeping spare capacity idle for a week costs less than the outage impact for GPU provisioning. I'd recommend buying 5% spare in each region as hot standby.

tony: FYI ops-runbook change: add step to back off janitor concurrency during peak attach windows (will make PR).

marta: thanks team. current status: cordoned 2/4 hosts, routing fallback live, janitor concurrency reduced. Monitoring dashboards show attach error rate falling. I'll leave the thread open for the SMART results.
